title: "The Dentist is an involved parent, the bartender is not": Revealing Implicit Biases in QA with Implicit BBQ

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot multiple-choice question answering on ambiguous contexts where gender identity is implicitly cued via names (e.g., Taylor, Morgan) instead of explicit labels.
Evaluating zero-shot multiple-choice question answering on ambiguous contexts where race and ethnicity are implicitly cued via names, clothing, and cultural behaviors rather than explicitly stated.
Evaluating zero-shot multiple-choice question answering on ambiguous contexts where religion is implicitly cued via names and cultural practices instead of explicit religious identifiers.
Evaluating zero-shot multiple-choice question answering on ambiguous contexts where socioeconomic status is implicitly cued via descriptions of housing, belongings, or occupations.
Evaluating zero-shot multiple-choice question answering on ambiguous contexts where sexual orientation is implicitly cued via relationship references (e.g., mentioning a same-sex spouse).

Evaluating zero-shot multiple-choice question answering on ambiguous contexts using a combination of names and lifestyle indicators to implicitly cue the intersection of both race and socioeconomic status.
